endpoint_failure_evidence.source: completed high endpoint s2 traces; no requalification

interpretation.coarse_source0: At the largest coarse/prod CDF bound (t≈1.93869 s, 0.0390625), source-field macro deltas are small in velocity (−7.14e−4 m/s) and kinetic energy (−4.77e−3 J); paired contributing seeds have no wall visibility rejection, no rank/ESS/candidate gate failures, and comparable ESS/support. This supports a spatial MLS/trajectory phase difference, while the reference transport and reconstruction effects remain coupled.
interpretation.coarse_source1: At t≈0.68565 s, CDF bound 0.0234375; reference density/velocity differences remain small, all contributing seeds are near the wall by the 2h proxy but have no wall rejection or numerical gate failure. This is a near-wall spatial footprint difference rather than a recorded support-loss event.
interpretation.endpoint: The root endpoint report is retained as a related completed comparison; low/high endpoint CDF bounds remain above 0.02 even where unknown fractions are zero or small.
interpretation.fine_source0: At t≈6.58929 s, CDF bound 0.0546875; the fine reference has +0.02564 m/s mean velocity and +0.1805 J kinetic energy relative to production in the same window, while the paired contributor set has near-wall proxy fractions 0.769 vs 0.385 and fine seed 3 had already wall_occluded at 6.1700 s. This window contains both SPH reference transport divergence and MLS support/path divergence.
interpretation.fine_source1: At t≈0.67879 s, CDF bound 0.046875 with no unknown eligible at the peak; reference macro velocity/kinetic deltas are −0.00297 m/s/+0.00552 J, while support count/ESS differ and all contributors are near-wall by the 2h proxy without wall rejection. The evidence favors a spatial reconstruction/trajectory difference over a hard support failure, but does not isolate frozen-time error.
interpretation.qualification: No T2 or material-reliability claim; the 1% per-source unknown gate remains unchanged.

reference_numerical_dissipation_candidat.finding: 10 registered assets all have ViscoTreatment=1 and Visco=.05; h changes by resolution. This is a candidate for reference SPH long-time transport divergence only, without causal attribution in this diagnosis; it remains separate from native cadence/time-hold, MLS support and quadrature.

interpretation.substeps: Nominal center s2-vs-s4 reports show CDF sup ≤0.015625 and endpoint errors ≤3.29e−5 m (fine), so increasing RK substeps alone is not a sufficient explanation for the much larger cross-resolution bounds.
interpretation.unknown_vs_event: Nominal coarse/prod/fine differences persist in observed first-passage CDF while unknown mass is 0 for source1 and at most 0.00390625 for the nominal pairs; they are not explainable as a denominator-only unknown artifact.
